mappings.exact_guidance: • The mechanisms by which data such as integers, strings, characters, images, audio and video are stored in binary form
mappings.assessed_skill: Describe one image binary-encoding mechanism using three 8-bit RGB components.
mappings.evidence: Image pixels are directly tested; integer/text/audio/video encoding mechanisms are not. A possible RGB scheme answers can represent; it is not asserted to be the only 24-bit encoding.
